name: revyl-cli
tagline_zh: 当你想让AI直接跑命令、写测试、排查运行问题，却不想折腾MCP配置时，Revyl CLI一句指令就上手。
tagline_en: Skip MCP setup—just say the command, and Revyl CLI handles shell env, test writing, and run triage in one go.
desc_en: Base CLI skill for Revyl command-driven workflows. Use when users want shell-command setup, execution, test authoring, or run triage without MCP tool calls.
why_zh: 同类要配MCP或写插件，它直接吃自然语言指令，自动搭shell环境，测试和排错一条龙，省掉中间层。
why_en: No MCP glue—parses plain commands, auto-provisions shell env, and bundles test authoring with run triage.
